sections.changelog:
Added

  • Clicking a category or brand in the live dropdown now narrows the current search to that term instead of opening the term's archive. The results page shows only products that match the typed query within the chosen category, so the dropdown becomes a way to drill down (e.g. search "стекло iPhone 12", click "Дисплеи" → only display parts for that query). Works for any listed category or brand taxonomy, independent of the optional scope-selector setting. The chosen category and the form's type scope both travel to the results page.

Changed

  • Product titles in the live dropdown now wrap to two lines before truncating, instead of being cut off on a single line, so long product names remain readable.
